name: Capybaras VS Plants
desc:
In Capybaras VS Plants,

🥚 Hatch CAPYBARAS to fight PLANTS for you!
💸 The PLANTS generate money online AND offline!
🌧️ WEATHERS will occur and mutate your plants and capybaras!

Collect RARE plants and capybaras!

👍 Like and favorite the game!
💻 Available on Desktop, Laptop, Mobile, Tablet, and Console!
